lines.text: The psalmist says he has done what is just and right and asks not to be left to his oppressors.
His eyes fail looking for the LORD's salvation, and he asks to be dealt with according to loving devotion.
The psalmist loves the LORD's commandments more than silver and hates every false way.
The unfolding of God's words gives light and informs the proud, and the psalmist pants, longing for the LORD's commandments.
Trouble and distress find the psalmist, but the commandments are his delight, and he seeks understanding that he may live.
